description: Draws a backdrop behind the whole rack: a colour or gradient, an image, and virtual skiffs around the modules, all set up in the Purf Stylee menu

params.text: Draws the backdrop while lit, and leaves the rack as it was when unlit
Opens the module and patch title options

notes: no backdrop is drawn until the module is made active with the button on its panel
menu: Module & Patch Title, in the Purf Stylee submenu, draws the name of the patch file down the panel, and sets the size, colour and direction of that text
Colour Background, in the Purf Stylee submenu, fills a layer below the modules with a colour, or with a linear, radial or box gradient between two colours
Image Background, in the Purf Stylee submenu, renders a loaded image below or above the colour layer, tiled or scaled, with its own position and offsets
Skiff, in the Purf Stylee submenu, draws boxes around the modules with a bezel, rails and a shadow, and can split them into several boxes by row or by gaps
Show Icon Menus hides the four menu buttons on the panel
